task: Which building was completed first the W. R. Grace Building or 10 Hudson Yards?
answer:
**The W. R. Grace Building was completed first.**

| Building | Year Completed |
|----------|----------------|
| **W. R. Grace Building** (1114 Avenue of the Americas, Manhattan) | **1970** (construction finished and the building opened in 1970) |
| **10 Hudson Yards** (Manhattan) | **2019** (the tower was topped out in 2018 and opened to tenants in 2019) |

Because the Grace Building opened in 1970, more than four decades before 10 Hudson Yards was finished in 2019, it was the earlier of the two structures.
